Slop Time · In development

World clock and time zones

World clock, meeting planner and time zones. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Nothing to install: just open it in the browser on your phone, tablet or computer. It keeps working without internet after your first visit. Want an icon on your home screen? On iPhone or iPad, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, open the browser menu and tap Add to Home screen. On a computer, click the install icon in the address bar.

Slop Time has these main features: World clock and "my time in" overlap; Meeting planner across time zones.

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.

What you can do with Slop Time

  • Time zone converter
  • Meeting planner for time zones
  • Online stopwatch and countdown timer
  • A timeanddate.com alternative for world clocks and time zones
